info.description: State-changing calls need the admin token when CI_ADMIN_TOKEN is set; without it only loopback clients may change state. Reads need the read token (or the admin token) when CI_READ_TOKEN is set, except /api/health. Workspaces: the routes of a workspace are under /api/w/{ws}/…; the same routes under /api/… address the workspace "default".
